antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 8300nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in cardiomyocyte if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2025) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Mid-infrared 8.3um: water channel modulation at 36 THz, pulsed 10^-12s, 10min cycles targeting cco_water_channel in cardiomyocyte. Study reference: 2025 peer-reviewed paper shows ATP +15% rapid at 8300nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial ATP_synthase_F0F1 activation.
